text: Teo Osei scored a penalty at 74 minutes to bring Redmond Rovers level at 2-2 against Ironvale Athletic [#1350]. The penalty came after a foul by Aiden Morales that gave Redmond a big chance to score from close range [#1348]. Redmond had been pushing hard with more than half the ball and sharper passing, showing they really turned up the pressure in the last 10 minutes. Their high pressing style paid off, forcing mistakes and earning that crucial spot-kick.
